Installation

installation.Rmd

rupturesRcpp has a development version and a CRAN release. This guide documents the development version.

Development version

r-universe builds the development version from the main branch on GitHub, with binaries for Windows, macOS and Linux, so no compiler is needed:

install.packages("rupturesRcpp",
                 repos = c("https://edelweiss611428.r-universe.dev",
                           "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

To build it from source instead, you need a C++ toolchain: Rtools on Windows, or the Xcode command line tools on macOS.

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("edelweiss611428/rupturesRcpp")

CRAN release 

install.packages("rupturesRcpp")

The CRAN release (1.0.3) has binSeg, Window and PELT with the "L1", "L2", "SIGMA", "VAR" and "LinearL2" costs. The rest of this guide also uses features that are only in the development version, so some of its code fails on 1.0.3:

  • Dynp and costFactory;
  • the "LinearSIGMA", "LinearL1" and "Custom" costs;
  • $predict(nBkps = ...), $getHistory(), $plotElbow() and $segments().

Checking the installation 

packageVersion("rupturesRcpp")
#> [1] '2.0.0'

The packages rupturesRcpp depends on (Rcpp, R6, ggplot2 and patchwork) are installed with it.
